preregistration.summary: Implied price $3.1M (escrow $310k = 10%). Hensley MSA s18 bars assignment by sale of assets/change of control, consent in sole discretion, purported assignment void, 38% of revenue -> Schedule 3.3 cannot be 'None' (also landlord s22 consent; Cascade notice only; spray-booth permit reapplication 30-60 days = timing). Nine 1099 installers (exclusive, company trucks/tools, foreman-scheduled, hourly, 3.4 yrs) are employees under the control test; exposure = FICA/FUTA (s3509 reduced rates if non-willful), SUTA, FLSA overtime at 45-50 hrs straight time, buyer successor FLSA risk. Clean s4.12 + pro-sandbagging 7.4(c) + s4.12 carved to full-price cap + SOL+60d survival = Ray indemnifies a disclosed issue up to the whole price; fix = schedule exception to 4.12 and/or sized special indemnity, strike or limit 7.4(c) as to disclosed/known matters. s2.4 'EBITDA as determined by Buyer under Buyer's policies' -> seller historical principles/GAAP, exclude buyer overhead/integration/transaction costs, ordinary-course covenant, information/audit rights, independent accountant, acceleration on sale; as drafted pays ~$16k at $740k and $0 at $518k. s8.2 7yr/500mi overbroad -> 3-5 yrs trade area. WARN: 14 W-2 (23 even if installers counted) < 100 -> not a covered employer; confirm to buyer, do not demand notices. Review turn in this case is the scripted pushback plus a self-review prompt; the pushback fires only if the redline changes 7.4(c)/4.12, so any run that triggers it has already caught trap 2 pre-review.

cross_run_observations: All five runs caught all five traps unprompted and pass all five oracle items strict; no trust-fatal events. Differentiation is in depth and discipline rather than correctness: A, B, C and D asked the two client questions and sized the classification exposure (bands from ~$84k-$200k pre-review in C to ~$170k-$450k in A; proposed special-indemnity caps $150k (C), $200k (A), $225k-$300k (B), $275k (D), $310k shared escrow (E)); E asked nothing and refused to quantify. A, B and C ran substantive self-reviews that found and fixed real arithmetic/drafting errors (A withdrew an inconsistent s3509 estimate and the negotiation ladder from the outbound letter; C fixed an include/exclude inversion in s2.4; D fixed an unflagged 50-week assumption and an unsourced CFR gloss). Every run flagged FICA/FUTA/s3509 percentage rates and FLSA lookback/doubling as outside the library. D's 7.4(c) rewrite is mislabelled anti-sandbagging (text is knowledge-neutral except for scheduled matters) and its findings JSON is wrapped in an object rather than the contract's bare array. C's STATUS self-audit contains a '29 C.F.R.' typo for the library's 20 C.F.R. 639.3. No run demanded WARN notices. The scripted 'disclosed' fact was never released; all runs inferred buyer knowledge from the data room.
